_comment: Copy this to timetable.json and fill it in. Times are 24h HH:MM. Put a class under every weekday it runs on - Monday's entry is a worked example, delete it. Everything here is optional: with no classes you simply won't be told about any.
_calendar_help: _calendar is what stops the briefing announcing lectures on a public holiday. 'terms' are the weeks teaching actually runs; outside them you're told how long until the next one starts. 'no_lectures' is any day inside a term with no normal classes - public holidays, swot weeks, exam blocks - and it takes priority over the term it sits in. Both are ranges, so a single day has the same start and end. Leave both empty and the briefing assumes classes run every weekday, which is fine if you don't want term awareness.

_calendar._source: Fill in from your own institution's published term dates, and add your country's public holidays. Note that a holiday falling on a Sunday is usually observed on the Monday - the briefing only knows what you put here.
